definitions.explanation: A bank account primarily used by businesses for issuing checks and making frequent transactions. Unlike savings accounts, it typically does not earn interest.

examples.japanese: {当座預金|とうざよきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開設|かいせつ}する→開設する：30272_kaisetsusuru⟧。
{当座預金|とうざよきん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{利息|りそく}→利息：05469_risoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかない。
⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{支払|しはら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当座預金|とうざよきん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行|おこな}われる→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Company payments are made by check from the checking account.

notes:
A financial term composed of ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧ (current; for the time being) + ⟦{預金|よきん}→預金：05420_yokin⟧ (deposit; savings). In Japan, {当座預金|とうざよきん} accounts are used mainly by businesses and are linked to ⟦{小切手|こぎって}→小切手：06305_kogitte⟧ (check) transactions. Individuals typically use ⟦{普通預金|ふつうよきん}→普通預金：23520_futsuuyokin⟧ (ordinary savings accounts) for everyday banking.

- {当座預金|とうざよきん}{口座|こうざ}: checking account

- ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧⟦{取引|とりひき}→取引：04700_torihiki⟧: current account transactions
- ⟦{当座|とうざ}→当座：29548_touza⟧{借越|かりこし}: overdraft

- ⟦{普通預金|ふつうよきん}→普通預金：23520_futsuuyokin⟧: ordinary savings account — the most common type of individual bank account in Japan
